I posted two replies in #strategic-random's thread for Gideon, and the first was wrong. It said there was no Orlavine figure in his channels, but I hadn't checked #strategic-random, and the search did return a match. The second reply corrects that.

The match is a "Moss: Strategic digest 9/30" note addressed to Ruth. It says Orlavine Medical Supply is at 55 seats. I don't know whether Gideon can read that note, so I didn't quote the number or the date. Gideon can ask Ruth directly.
